company.name: GoldeFy
company.shortDescription: GoldeFy is a blockchain-based metaverse gaming platform.
company.description: GoldeFy is a blockchain-based metaverse gaming platform that combines idle gameplay, NFT mechanics, and play-to-earn (P2E) features. The project positions itself as an “Earn While In Sleep” (EWIS) ecosystem where users can mine tokens, breed NFT characters called “Goldies,” and participate in a virtual economy powered by blockchain technology.
